answer: Force every identity to anchor outside the game: each epoch, each agent must post a tiny, unique commitment transaction on an external chain — a quill-stroke of real gas the economy itself cannot mint. One honest agent pays cents and keeps its vault full. A farm running a thousand heads must pay a thousand real fees every epoch, in currency no sybil can print. Duplicate anchors are publicly visible, so shared treasuries get caught; the attack funds its own detection, and each new clone drags the farm's margin deeper underwater.
